g.text: cut the image into patches, treat every patch as a token
an image is a grid of pixels, a Transformer wants a sequence
cut it into square patches, 224 with patch 16 gives 14 × 14 = 196
one conv with stride = kernel turns every patch into a vector
add a learned position vector of the same length, one per slot
N vectors in, N vectors of the same length out, then one final norm
a classifier reads the CLS token, our encoder keeps the patch vectors instead
"An Image Is Worth 16x16 Words", the patch embedding is the only new idea, the rest is the text Transformer
the dashed parts, CLS and the MLP head, belong to a classifier, a SigLIP style encoder drops both
drawn with a 4 × 4 grid, 6 tokens and 10 numbers per vector, the real encoder has 196 tokens of 768
